name: Konayuki Fururi ~Yuzuhara-chou Curling-bu~
original_name: こなゆき ふるり　～柚子原町カーリング部～
source:
There is a small town located in the country. Tetsuya lives a boring life there. One day, he is appointed to a coach of a curling team. He doesn't want to do that, but he reluctantly accepts it. His players are all pretty, but older than him. Also, they are beginners like him. Like this, his busy life begins....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
乡间有一座小镇，哲也在那里过着无聊的生活。某天，他被任命为冰壶队教练。他不愿接下这项工作，却还是勉强答应。队员们个个漂亮，而且都比他年长，不过也和他一样是初学者。就这样，他忙碌的生活开始了……

[摘自ErogeShop]
